programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: For their first pattern challenge, the sewers tackle an A-line skirt. The alteration challenge sees the sewers alter the neckline of a high street top. In the final challenge, They must make a day dress to fit their live models. One sewer is awarded garment of the week whilst two leave the Sewing Bee.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Series 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Six home sewers return to the sewing room to compete in three more challenges; to follow a pattern for a pair of men’s trousers, to add patch pockets to a skirt and to create a made-to-measure silk blouse for their model. The slippery fabric is too much for two of the sewers who leave the Sewing Bee

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: The semi-final and four amateur sewers compete in 3 more challenges. Patrick Grant and May Martin set them a pattern for a child’s dress, in the alteration challenge they are asked to tailor a dress with precision and they create a made-to-measure jacket to fit their model.

programme.title: the Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: The three finalists compete in three tough challenges to decide who will take the title of Britain’s best amateur sewer. They follow a pattern for a man’s shirt, show off their hand sewing skills and for the finale they are asked to create a stunning made-to-measure evening dress in a luxury fabric

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 1
programme.desc: The first episode tests the sewers with cotton, wool and silk fabrics. The Pattern Challenge tasks the sewers with making a simple tunic top. In the Alteration Challenge the sewers transform a plain woollen skirt. Finally, the sewers are asked to fit a made-to-measure silk night gown for a model.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Claudia Winkleman welcomes the home sewers back to the sewing room. In 3 challenges the sewers follow a pattern for a pleated skirt, be imaginative to combine men’s shirts into one garment and finally make made-to-measure men’s patterned pyjamas which must match and fit their male models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: The eight remaining amateur sewers are tested with a pattern for a simple pair of leggings, asked to turn an oversized t-shirt into another garment and finally, they face the most fitted made to measure challenge yet. Who will win garment of the week and who will leave the Sewing Bee.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: They face 3 challenges to test their ability to make children’s clothes, starting with toddler dungarees. The alteration challenge sees the sewers rustling up a fancy dress outfit and finally they must create a spectacular made to measure prom dress for a teenager model.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: This week, for the first time the sewers handle something which isn’t a textile – as a high street top is transformed with leather and in a new twist to the series, they pair up to be each other’s ‘fit buddies’ when they are asked to make a pair of trousers for themselves – in delicate velvet.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Savile Row’s Patrick Grant and sewing teacher, May Martin surprise the sewers with a 1930s silky blouse pattern challenge, turn a man’s suit into a wearable woman’s garment. Finally, in the made to measure challenge a complex and hefty coat is made from a vintage pattern.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 7
programme.desc: The semi finals face 3 challenges; none of which have a pattern for guidance. First, they demonstrate their ability to make a dress out of piece of fabric straight onto the mannequin. In the made to measure they make a new copy of their favourite garment. Who will be rewarded with a place in the final?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.sub-title: The Great British Sewing Bee Season 2 Episode 8
programme.desc: Sewing expert, May Martin and Savile Row’s Patrick Grant must decide who will take the title of Britain’s best amateur sewer as they set 3 ‘Couture’ themed challenges. Family, friends and the rest of the contestants are reunited to see one person crowned the winner of The Great British Sewing Bee.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
